summary: Are identifying miscues and cueing systems during running records as MSV stupid. Yes, might as well throw darts at the wall....useless...but so is much of the diagnostic reading assessment. We know the type of systematic decoding skills readers need.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: Are identifying miscues and cueing systems during running records as MSV stupid. Yes, might as well throw darts at the wall....useless...but so is much of the diagnostic reading assessment. We know the type of systematic decoding skills readers need.
